payload.text: I used to believe that fully remote work was non-negotiable, because I prized uninterrupted focus and the freedom to arrange my day without an office watching the clock. I now prefer a hybrid model—three days in person per week—balancing solitude for deep work with human contact to maintain energy and judgment. My mind changed because I realized isolation has a real cost for me, even though freedom still matters.
